instructions.title: How to use JSON Formatter

steps.title: Paste your JSON data
steps.description: Copy and paste your JSON code into the input area. The tool accepts compressed, formatted, or malformed JSON and will analyze it immediately.

steps.title: Configure options
steps.description: Adjust indentation size, sort keys alphabetically, or choose validate-only mode to tailor the output to your preferences.

steps.title: Review the output
steps.description: The formatter beautifies your JSON with color-coded syntax highlighting and marks any errors with their exact line position in the code.

steps.title: Copy or download result
steps.description: Copy the formatted JSON to your clipboard for immediate use or download it as a file for storage and sharing.
